description: This is a Java test source file for the ModuleUtil class in the openmrs-core project. It contains unit tests for various utility methods related to module management, version parsing, resource handling, and jar expansion.

classes.name: ModuleUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the ModuleUtil utility class in various scenarios, including version matching, resource loading, jar expansion, and module path resolution.

methods.name: checkMandatoryModulesStarted_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfAMandatoryModuleIsNotStarted
methods.description: Tests that the utility correctly throws an exception if mandatory modules are not started.

methods.name: getMandatoryModules_shouldReturnMandatoryModuleIds
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of IDs of modules marked as mandatory.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenVersionsIsNull
methods.description: Checks that version-inclusion method returns false for null input.

methods.name: isOpenmrsVersionInVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenVersionsIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that version-inclusion method returns false when no versions are provided.

methods.name: getModuleForPath_shouldHandleUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssWhenUiDotSpringmvcModuleIsRunning
methods.description: Verifies module detection based on path when specific module is active.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfOpenmrsVersionBeyondWildCardRange
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when versions don't match requirements.

methods.name: compareVersion_shouldCorrectlyComparingTwoVersionNumbers
methods.description: Compares two version strings for correctness.

methods.name: file2url_shouldReturnNullIfFileIsNull
methods.description: Tests conversion of null File to URL.

methods.name: getPackagesFromFile_shouldReturnEmptyStringSetIfNonJarFile
methods.description: Tests package extraction from a non-jar file.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenVersionHasWildCardAndIsOutsideBoundary
methods.description: Version range boundary test with wildcards.
